results.name: Kettlebell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back resting against the edge of a bench, your knees bent, and your feet flat on the floor. Hold a kettlebell securely across your hips with both hands.
Press through your feet and lift your hips upward while keeping your upper back supported on the bench.
Continue lifting until your torso and thighs form a straight line, then squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower your hips with control to the starting position, then repeat.
tips: Keep your upper back firmly supported on the bench throughout the movement.
Press through your heels and midfoot as you lift.
Fully extend your hips without arching your lower back.
Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Kettlebell Hip Thrust is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Core.

results.name: Kettlebell Lateral Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width apart. Hold a kettlebell in each hand with an overhand grip in front of your thighs.
Step one foot out to the side, bend that knee, and push your hips back while keeping your opposite leg straight.
Lean your torso slightly forward and lower the kettlebells toward the floor between your legs.
Push through your bent leg to return to the starting position, then repeat.
tips: Push your hips back as you lower instead of dropping straight down.
Keep your back straight as your torso leans forward.
Keep the knee of your bent leg aligned with your toes.
Inhale as you lower and exhale as you return to standing.
results.description: Kettlebell Lateral Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Core, Forearms.

results.name: Kettlebell Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width apart and hold a kettlebell in each hand by your sides using a neutral grip.
Step one foot backward and lower your back knee toward the floor while bending your front knee.
Push through your front foot to rise and bring your back foot forward to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your chest lifted and your torso stable.
Lower your back knee close to the floor without letting it touch.
Keep your front knee aligned with your toes.
Inhale as you lower and exhale as you return to standing.
results.description: Kettlebell Reverse Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Core, Forearms.

results.name: Kettlebell Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit upright on a bench with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor. Rest a kettlebell on your thighs just above your knees and hold it securely with both hands.
Keep the balls of your feet on the floor and raise both heels as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your calves.
Lower your heels back to the floor with control, then repeat.
tips: Raise both heels evenly at the same time.
Avoid bouncing at the bottom of the movement.
Lower your heels slowly through the full range of motion.
Exhale as you raise your heels and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Kettlebell Seated Calf Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on your left leg and hold a kettlebell in your left hand using a neutral grip. Bend your right knee and keep your right foot raised behind you.
Keep your left leg straight and press through the ball of your left foot to raise your heel.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your calf.
Lower your left heel to the floor with control, then repeat before switching sides.
tips: Keep your supporting leg straight without locking your knee.
Keep your raised foot off the floor throughout the movement.
Lower your heel slowly without dropping.
Exhale as you raise your heel and inhale as you lower it.
results.description: Kettlebell Single Leg Calf Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms, Core.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and hold a kettlebell in your left hand using an overhand grip. Keep a slight bend in your right knee and lift your left foot slightly off the floor.
Shift your weight toward the right leg, push your hips back and lean your torso forward as you extend your left leg straight behind you.
Lower the kettlebell toward the floor beside your right leg while keeping your back straight and your hips level.
Press through your right foot and bring your hips forward to return upright, then repeat before switching sides.
tips: Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Keep your hips level and avoid rotating to either side.
Move slowly and maintain your balance throughout each repetition.
Inhale as you lower and exhale as you return upright.
results.description: Kettlebell Single Leg Deadlift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Core, Forearms.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and that foot flat, holding a kettlebell on your hips.
Lift your other leg straight.
Press through the heel of the planted foot to lift your hips.
Lower and repeat, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your hips level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
results.description: Kettlebell Single Leg Glute Bridge is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Core.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a kettlebell on your hips.
Plant one foot flat and lift the other leg.
Drive through the planted heel to lift your hips until your thigh is parallel to the floor.
Lower and repeat, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your hips square.
Hold the bell steady with both hands.
results.description: Kettlebell Single Leg Hip Thrust is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Quadriceps.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Romanian Deadlifts
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a kettlebell in the opposite hand.
Hinge at your hips and extend your free leg straight behind you.
Lower the bell toward the floor with a flat back.
Return to standing by driving your hips forward, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your hips square to the floor.
Keep a slight bend in the standing knee.
results.description: Kettlebell Single Leg Romanian Deadlifts is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Core.

results.name: Kettlebell Staggered Deadlift
instructions: Stand with one foot slightly behind the other and hold a kettlebell in front of you.
Keep most of your weight on the front leg.
Hinge at your hips to lower the bell toward the floor with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then switch the front leg.
tips: The back foot is only for balance.
Keep the kettlebell close to your legs.
results.description: Kettlebell Staggered Deadlift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.
